interface: published VLABench pi05 primitive pose control

checkpoint_selection.metric: Total official successes across the same 12 development cases, using one checkpoint for all tasks.

correction_recipe.description: Reference parent, shortest equivalent Euler labels, executed-pose flow loss, gripper weight 5, frozen action heads, verified expert corrections.

expanded_data_phase.initialization: correction-multitask-400 at update 400; a fresh optimizer and additional replay-verified training demonstrations

follow_up_registered_before_final_outcom.selection: Compare complete 12-case development results only. Use one checkpoint for every task. Maximize total official successes; ties choose fewer cumulative optimizer updates, then the earlier registered recipe.
follow_up_registered_before_final_outcom.baseline_blinding: The fixed published-reference final suite may run concurrently. Do not inspect its outcomes until SFT recipe and checkpoint are frozen.

checkpoint_selection.reserved: Do not use ordinary or fruit_language outcomes for checkpoint selection.

ordinary.initialization_rule: First 20 distinct physics-valid resets per task in ascending order from 1501. Record all rejected reset errors before any policy evaluation.

excluded_initializations.reason: Reset PhysicsError on all four attempts before executing any policy.
